messages:
Anya: Quick design check — pushed a small change to the roles matrix in Figma. Link: https://figma.com/file/abc123/perms-compact. Goal: reduce vertical height for admins view, keep audit link discoverable. Thoughts? :eyes:
Matt: Like the compact rows, but concerned about keyboard focus — where does focus go when you open a role row?
Jordan: We should keep first focus on role name button, then tab to actions. Avoid trapping in a hidden flyout.
Priya: Copy nit: "Invite members" -> "Add members" matches other consoles. Also the SSO toggle label feels technical; maybe "Require SSO login"?
Anya: Good call on copy. Matt — can you paste the focus order we'd like? Also thinking of moving SSO toggle from org header into Security tab to avoid accidental toggles.
Matt: Focus order: role-row button -> expand panel -> primary "Assign" -> secondary "Remove" -> close. I'll paste snippet:
`roleRow.focus(); // open -> btnAssign.focus();`
Jordan: Moving SSO to Security tab is fine, but we need a clear in-context note on existing sessions. If moved, include a tooltip: "Changes affect new sessions only."
Priya: Accessibility: when opening role expansion it must set aria-expanded and role=region + aria-labelledby to the header; and ensure announce for screenreaders: "Role editor opened: Admins".
Sam (AccessBot): Audit note: changing SSO placement will alter event routing. Action created: AUD-482 to update audit-log link targets. :robot_face:
Anya: Thanks Sam. One more UX question — the invite flow: when someone pastes a list of emails, do we show inline validation per row or validate on submit? My preference: inline validation to surface typos.
Jordan: Inline but async — validate as they type, error messages inline, and overall summary at top on submit. Keep inline errors non-modal.
Matt: Also we should show seat delta upfront: "You're inviting 5 members — this will use 5 seats" (small gray hint under invite CTA).
Priya: Microcopy for that hint: `Adds {n} seats to your plan` (not "Uses"). Tone softer.
Anya: Ok action items — Jordan will wireframe keyboard flow, Priya will draft copy strings, Matt will update Figma placement for SSO. Assigning: @Jordan @Priya @Matt. :thumbsup:
Jordan: I'll upload the keyboard flow by EOD and include alt text for images.
Priya: Drafting copy now, will PR to docs repo when done.
Matt: Figma updated, pushed small diff to the file. @Anya can you review?
Anya: Reviewing now, will do a quick pass and merge tomorrow. Thanks everyone!
